crop.notes: Most of the clipping (crop-1, crop-2) is an unrelated census committee notice and list of census questions; only 'The Prize Fight Fiasco' at the bottom of crop-2 and crop-3 is about Allen. The Allen item itself is complete.

ocr.notes: Allen item readable; 'Koach' for Roach, '32.500aside' for $2,500 a side. OCR includes the census notice.

title.suggested: McCoole-Allen fight in doubt after missed deposit

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that McCoole's side failed to pay the second $500 deposit for the McCoole-Allen fight set for September 13, leaving the match in doubt; Allen, done with his eastern tour, was expected home.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, July 2, 1870' - not yet the St. Louis Republic (1888).

facts.fact: The McCoole-Allen fight was made for $2,500 a side, to come off on September 13, 1870; $1,000 had been deposited
No one appeared for McCoole to pay the second deposit of $500 a side to Mr. Murray, the pawnbroker; Roach, Allen's representative, claimed the stakes and many considered the fight off
Allen, having completed his eastern tour, was expected back in St. Louis

notes: Deposit date taken as 'yesterday afternoon' relative to the July 2 paper. The Allen item is the only relevant part of the clipping, hence primary.
